name: Reduce idena-node Docker image size (base image + build optimizations)

description: Baseline: ubuntu:22.04 for both stages, 179.1 MB

asi.notes: update-dist.sh runs apt-get upgrade+dist-upgrade at build time adding layer bloat

description: Remove update-dist.sh: zero savings — main RUN already runs apt-get upgrade so dist-upgrade adds 0 bytes

asi.rollback_reason: identical size 187750340 bytes — packages already upgraded in main RUN layer
asi.next_action_hint: switch base image from ubuntu:22.04 to debian:bookworm-slim for ~40-50MB savings

description: debian:bookworm-slim (both stages) + remove apt-get -y upgrade → 174.8 MB (-4.3 MB)

asi.hypothesis: debian:bookworm-slim + no apt upgrade saves space

description: Remove update-dist.sh call + strip doc/man/locale → 174.2 MB (-0.6 MB from prev, -4.9 MB from baseline)

asi.next_action_hint: try autoremove + more aggressive cleanup, or explore distroless/scratch if binary is statically linked

description: autoremove + /var/log /tmp cleanup: only 0.1 MB - within noise, not worth the change

asi.next_action_hint: explore dropbear instead of openssh-server (much smaller), or check if binary is statically linked for distroless

description: Replace openssh-server with dropbear → 165.9 MB (-8.3 MB vs prev, -13.2 MB vs baseline). All tests pass.

asi.hypothesis: dropbear is much smaller than openssh-server

description: Replace curl with wget → 161.9 MB (-4 MB vs prev, -17.2 MB/-9.6% vs baseline). curl pulls 15 extra pkgs, wget only 2.

asi.hypothesis: wget has far fewer dependencies than curl

description: Alpine runtime + glibc copié depuis Debian (3.2 MB) → 99.3 MB (-62.6 MB/-38.7% vs précédent, -79.8 MB/-44.6% vs baseline). Tous tests OK.

asi.hypothesis: Alpine base (8.1 MB) + glibc .so copiés depuis Debian stage = bien plus petit que debian:bookworm-slim (71.4 MB)

description: Supprimer shadow (remplacer useradd→adduser busybox) → 97.1 MB (-2.2 MB). Tous tests OK.

asi.hypothesis: Alpine a adduser+chpasswd natifs via busybox, shadow inutile

description: UPX -1 (6.7s build) sur binaire strippé : 82.6→36.3 MB (44%) → image 53 MB (-44 MB/-45% vs précédent, -70.4% vs baseline). Tous tests OK.

asi.hypothesis: UPX -1 (fast) compresse le binaire Go de 82.6→36.3 MB en 6.7s

description: UPX -5 vs -1 : binary 36.3→31 MB → image 49 MB (-4 MB). Même vitesse de build (~7s). Tous tests OK.

asi.hypothesis: UPX -5 meilleur ratio que -1 pour vitesse similaire

description: Remplacer GNU wget par busybox wget (déjà dans Alpine) → 45.8 MB (-3.2 MB). Scripts réécrits avec -U/-T + boucle retry bash. Tous tests OK.

asi.hypothesis: busybox wget inclus dans Alpine base, GNU wget inutile

description: Remplacer bash par sh POSIX (−2 MB) : scripts→#!/bin/sh, tableaux→strings, ERR traps supprimés, healthcheck→nc 127.0.0.1, lib.sh adapté. Tous tests OK.

asi.hypothesis: busybox sh remplace bash (2 MB économisés : bash+readline+ncurses)
